narrative.overview:
A dark sports hall with the light on the table. The page is the unlit room: near-black, colourless and quiet. What matters right now is what gets lit: a photo, a headline, a league table. Crest Red is the one coloured light in the building, and it only ever marks what is in play: the active link, the current section, the next action.

The system is confident and athletic. Tall condensed headlines stand at full height and speak in capitals, the way a name reads on a hall banner. Controls are compact and move fast. Full-screen photo panels do the heavy lifting, with small, precise interface details around them rather than decoration. Density stays low on the home page and tightens only where the data needs it, such as the league table.

The site must never read as corporate and sterile, with polish and no sport in it. It must never read as a playful kids' club either, even though youth work is central to the club's story. Youth is shown with the same seriousness as the first team.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black, fully neutral surfaces with a single red accent taken from the crest.
Thunder in tall condensed capitals for headlines; Geist for reading and data.
Full-bleed photo panels under a dark overlay, with text set directly on them.
Dark pages broken by bright white bands.
Flat at rest; shadow and glow appear only on glass over photos or in response to touch.
Compact controls with a forward double arrow and a quick press-in on hover.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Crest Red is the only hue in the interface. Neutrals carry no tint, and no second accent is added. Colour in a photo is welcome; colour in the interface is not.

rules.name: The In Play Rule
rules.body: Red marks what is active or actionable. If nothing is happening there, it isn't red.

rules.name: The Text Floor Rule
rules.body: Ash Grey is the lowest text colour on dark (6.50:1 on Hall Black). Line Grey measures 2.85:1 and is for lines only. The news indicator numbers currently break this rule and should be raised when next touched.

rules.name: The Red Type Rule
rules.body: Crest Red on Hall Black measures 3.69:1, so on dark it is for shapes and large text only. Small red text belongs on Floodlight White (4.83:1). White text on Crest Red also measures 4.83:1.

rules.name: The Latin Only Rule
rules.body: Thunder has every Serbian Latin letter (Š, Đ, Č, Ć, Ž) but no Cyrillic at all. Scraped team names arrive in Cyrillic, so they always stay in Geist. Never set unconverted Cyrillic data in a Thunder style.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Thunder is for names and headlines; Geist is for reading and data. Thunder never sets a paragraph, and Geist never sets a page headline.

rules.name: The Band Rule
rules.body: Bright white bands break the dark page at section level: the gallery preview, the upcoming matches and the top of the footer. Use them to change the pace, not as a background for every other section.

rules.name: The Lit Photo Rule
rules.body: Text sits directly on full-bleed photos under a flat 65% black overlay. The photo stays visible and the text stays readable; no gradient scrims or text boxes.

rules.name: The Flat at Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow at rest unless it is glass over a photo. Cards, forms and post panels stay flat and rise by tone.

rules.name: The Glow Answers Touch Rule
rules.body: Red glow is a reaction, never a decoration. It appears on hover and leaves with the pointer.

rules.name: The Square Marker Rule
rules.body: Small brand marks are squares, not dots or pills. There are no pill shapes in this system.

dos: Do use the existing variables in `src/index.css`. The OKLCH values are the source of truth.
Do keep red for what is active or actionable, following the One Light and In Play rules.
Do set headlines in uppercase Thunder and everything readable in Geist.
Do keep Geist for any Cyrillic or scraped data.
Do use a 65% black overlay when setting text on a full-bleed photo.
Do end every button with the double arrow.
Do add a visible focus state to any control you build or touch; none exist yet.
Do respect reduced-motion preferences in new motion work; the site doesn't handle this yet, including its smooth scrolling.
Do design for missing images, excerpts and translations, using the Charcoal well as the fallback.
donts: Don't drift towards a corporate, sterile look with polish and no sport in it.
Don't drift towards a playful kids' club look, even on youth content.
Don't add a second accent colour or tint the neutrals.
Don't use Line Grey for text.
Don't put small Crest Red text on dark surfaces.
Don't add shadows to surfaces at rest, or use glow as decoration.
Don't use pill shapes or round dots for small marks.
Don't use Body size (0.75rem) for paragraphs.
Don't set unconverted Cyrillic text in Thunder.
